Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states "The Lesser Sundra Islands," which is a group of islands in Indonesia. The Predicted Answer provides specific islands: Komodo, Rinca, Padar, Gili Motang, Nusa Kode, and parts of Flores. All of these islands are part of the Lesser Sunda Islands (also known as Nusa Tenggara). Thus, the substance of the Ground Truth Answer is present in the Predicted Answer, since all listed islands fall within the Lesser Sunda Islands group.

Decision: TRUE
